title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 8. Insists that all new policies and joint efforts in the area of defence should respect the sovereignty of Member States, ensuring that any action or coordination within the EU does not infringe on national competencies in military procurement; underlines the importance of empowering the EU nations to defend their national interests, safeguarding their values, interests and citizens; emphasises that defence and military procurement decisions should remain under the competence of individual Member States, and that the EU should not impose collective solutions on military capabilities;
